opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation; UK citizens and EEA nationals eligible; early‑career postdoctoral researchers.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award to support early‑career researchers to undertake an independent research project leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, with a permanent or fixed‑term position.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research up to 24 months, up to £200,000.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher across career stages in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funding for public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, up to £8,000.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Support skill development and methodological innovation, up to 12 months, £10,000 maximum.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in humanities or social sciences, post‑doctoral or above, with international co‑applicants.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, 24‑month award, up to £300,000.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowship hosted at DGAP in Berlin, up to £150,000.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers based in the UK or Germany, humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Symposium attendance with travel, accommodation and visa costs funded; interdisciplinary focus on humans and nature.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (higher possible in exceptional circumstances)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants needing support to apply for a British Academy award.
opportunities.summary: Funding for additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or application support.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (including independent scholars) ordinarily resident in the UK, with UK institution affiliation.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants up to £10,000 for projects up to 24 months.
